stories.title: Freed Israeli Hostages Still Had Shrapnel in Their Bodies From Oct. 7 Attack
stories.summary: Some freed Israeli hostages still had shrapnel in their bodies from the October 7 attack, according to an Israeli medical official. The official said some of the women were held alone for long periods and spent eight months in tunnels.
